title: Identification of novel biomarkers and associated immunoregulatory network in pterygium through integrated transcriptome analysis and machine learning approaches.
authors: Lyu, Ning; Xiang, Jun; Wu, Jiawen; Fan, Yidan; Lyu, Zhaoyuan; Gu, Jiayu; Cheng, Jingyi; Xu, Jianjiang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组和机器学习识别翼状胬肉生物标志物，虽涉及TF分析但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法为纯表达统计，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pterygium is a common eye disease with unclear pathogenesis. This study aims to identify novel biomarkers for pterygium and explore their mechanisms by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq). Twelve conjunctival and sixteen pterygium samples were collected for RNA-seq. Differential expression analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), and protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis were conducted. Multiple machine learning algorithms including XGBoost, Boruta, and LASSO were employed to identify biomarkers. The diagnostic value of biomarkers was evaluated through ROC curve analysis. To explore the functions of biomarkers, gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), immune infiltration, lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA regulatory network, master regulator analysis (MRA), and transcription factor (TF) mRNA analysis were conducted. qRT-PCR was performed to validate the expression levels of biomarkers. Five novel biomarkers (HSPA8, HBB, ARRB1, IRS1, and FLT4) associated with pterygium were identified. The nomogram model incorporating these biomarkers showed excellent diagnostic performance (AUC = 1). GSEA revealed that these biomarkers were primarily involved in oxidative phosphorylation, cytokine receptor interaction, and chemokine signaling pathways. 168 miRNAs and 1039 lncRNAs related to these biomarkers were predicted in the ceRNA regulatory network. MRA identified Retinoic acid receptor alpha (RARalpha) as a key TF regulating these biomarkers. Immune infiltration analysis showed significant differences in 22 types of immune cells between pterygium and control groups. The differential expression of five biomarkers was validated using qRT-PCR (all p < 0.05). This study identified five novel pterygium biomarkers (HSPA8, HBB, ARRB1, IRS1, & FLT4) and revealed a complex immunoregulatory network involving immune cells, lncRNA, miRNAs, and TFs (RARalpha).
abstract_zh: 翼状胬肉是一种常见的眼部疾病，其发病机制尚不明确。本研究旨在通过RNA测序（RNA-seq）识别翼状胬肉的新型生物标志物，并探讨其机制。收集了12个结膜样本和16个翼状胬肉样本进行RNA-seq。进行了差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析。采用包括XGBoost、Boruta和LASSO在内的多种机器学习算法来识别生物标志物。通过ROC曲线分析评估了生物标志物的诊断价值。为探讨生物标志物的功能，进行了基因集富集分析（GSEA）、免疫浸润、lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA调控网络、主调控因子分析（MRA）和转录因子（TF）mRNA分析。通过qRT-PCR验证了生物标志物的表达水平。识别出五个与翼状胬肉相关的新型生物标志物（HSPA8、HBB、ARRB1、IRS1和FLT4）。包含这些生物标志物的列线图模型显示出优异的诊断性能（AUC = 1）。GSEA揭示这些生物标志物主要参与氧化磷酸化、细胞因子受体相互作用和趋化因子信号通路。在ceRNA调控网络中预测了与这些生物标志物相关的168个miRNA和1039个lncRNA。MRA识别出维甲酸受体α（RARalpha）作为调控这些生物标志物的关键转录因子。免疫浸润分析显示翼状胬肉组与对照组之间在22种免疫细胞类型中存在显著差异。通过qRT-PCR验证了五个生物标志物的差异表达（所有p < 0.05）。本研究识别出五个新型翼状胬肉生物标志物（HSPA8、HBB、ARRB1、IRS1和FLT4），并揭示了涉及免疫细胞、lncRNA、miRNA和转录因子（RARalpha）的复杂免疫调控网络。
